findings.one_line: The matching randomized lower bound is not reproduced: the LAN-to-Gaussian decision transfer simply asserts a weak limit interval kernel from length tightness, but length tightness does not give endpoint-location tightness; an escaping endpoint component must be controlled/replaced and the coverage and lower-semicontinuity passage then proved before the Gaussian minimax bound can be invoked.

cited_checks.note: The supplied attested BCR restatements match the invoked substrate: projection preserves semialgebraicity, compatible Nash/smooth stratifications exist for finite families, semialgebraic sets have finitely many components and connected ones are semialgebraically path connected, and semialgebraic curves are piecewise C1. Coefficient preservation over real algebraic numbers is the stated field-level instantiation of the projection result.
